spec.description:
This dashboard provides a resource usage overview of the Thanos components Querier, Query-Frontend, Compactor, Store, Receive, Receive-Distributor and Ruler.

It includes CPU and Memory requests, limits and usage (filtered to Thanos pods only). In addition, the last termination reason is plotted and the cache hit ratio is available.
